curiosities: The 1984 Macintosh was launched with Ridley Scott's '1984' Super Bowl advert.
The inside of the original case carries the signatures of the team that built it.
Myst and Bungie's Marathon were made for the Mac first.
Macs ran on Motorola 68000-family processors until Apple moved to PowerPC in 1994.
The first model has 128 KB of memory and a Motorola 68000 at 8 MHz.
Susan Kare designed its icons and fonts.
MacPaint and MacWrite came with it.
The Macintosh II of 1987 brought colour.
